name: Alibaba
description: Alibaba develops AI models and services through teams including Qwen, Wan and Taotian Group, and provides hosted inference through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. Its principal executive offices are in Hangzhou, China.

sources.notes: Alibaba Group's official FAQ lists the principal executive offices of its main operations at 969 West Wen Yi Road, Yuhang District, Hangzhou, China.
